{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:17.500
    | text      = I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:18.500
    | text      = So, Jordan, we start this off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:20.300
    | text      = And Alex has a bit of a take.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.939
    | text      = I think there's a bit of a cover up of the footage of the bridge being hit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:28.819
    | text      = There's a cover up of the footage?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.259
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.259
    | text      = For those who don't know, there was a cargo ship, lost power, veered off course, and hit
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.939
    | text      = one of the supports of the Francis Scott Key Bridge at like 1.30 in the morning, or so
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:41.339
    | text      = bridge collapsed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:43.459
    | text      = And Alex believes they're telling people, don't show the footage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:48.060
    | text      = Ladies and gentlemen, the governor of Maryland has asked the media not to show footage of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:55.699
    | text      = the collapsed bridge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:58.819
    | text      = That is something entirely new.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:01.819
    | text      = Did you hear the government say don't show footage on 9-11?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:07.100
    | text      = But now we're seeing reports that social media like Facebook is trying to block it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:14.279
    | text      = So Alex has some basic details wrong here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:16.459
    | text      = It wasn't the Maryland governor who made this request.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:18.860
    | text      = It was Baltimore's mayor, Brandon Scott.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:21.779
    | text      = His comments were directed towards media outlets like CNN, not social media, and the reason
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:25.699
    | text      = he gave was, quote, no one needs to see the possibility of their family member being severely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:30.300
    | text      = injured or otherwise over and over again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.860
    | text      = It's just traumatizing our community.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:35.019
    | text      = And so I think there's a fair point that he makes, but I don't think there was any censoring
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.879
    | text      = of that video.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:40.879
    | text      = No, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.879
    | text      = It was all over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:42.879
    | text      = I think if you wanted to see it, you saw it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:45.180
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:46.180
    | text      = I think even if you didn't want to see it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:47.420
    | text      = I didn't want to see it, and I saw it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:49.379
    | text      = It's terrifying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:50.379
    | text      = I think especially before you realize that they were able to stop traffic on both sides.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.819
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:55.819
    | text      = Now granted, I'm not trying to take away from or minimize the fact that there were
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:59.620
    | text      = construction people who were on there who were missing and unaccounted for in a presumed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.420
    | text      = dead.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:05.420
    | text      = But you see a bridge collapse and your mind goes through, there must be a ton of cars
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:09.540
    | text      = on there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.540
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:11.540
    | text      = And so out of context seeing it is certainly robustly horrifying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:18.259
    | text      = 100%.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.259
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:20.259
    | text      = It is just like a reminder of the fragility of things that is like, hey.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:25.100
    | text      = And then at the same time, it's like, hey, if you throw 15,000 tons at something, it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:28.420
    | text      = going to break.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.420
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:30.420
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:31.420
    | text      = There's not much that can be done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:32.419
    | text      = There's not much that can stop 15,000 tons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:33.419
    | text      = I'm not positive what sort of bridge can withstand that kind of impact.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.100
    | text      = God knows.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:41.500
    | text      = But the boat lost power, and Alex has some thoughts about how they all require backups.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.460
    | text      = They all require backup power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.860
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:52.860
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.860
    | text      = The governor, oh, hey.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.860
    | text      = We got the clip we'll play in a moment, don't show the footage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:00.019
    | text      = There's nothing graphic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:01.019
    | text      = You don't see people being crushed or dying, though they are, though they're in the water.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.139
    | text      = That's been reported.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.139
    | text      = You have this huge bridge collapse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:10.179
    | text      = You have the power go out on a ship.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.779
    | text      = And I've done some research, those ships have battery power for at least lights around and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.700
    | text      = in the ship that kick on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.940
    | text      = And so I made some calls, did some research, and I noticed that General Flynn is saying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.820
    | text      = the same thing, that those ships of that size, by law, to be able to come into a port like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.419
    | text      = that, it's a hazardous waste port, one of the biggest in the U.S., have to have all
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.299
    | text      = these emergency battery systems and generator systems where you would not have the main
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:45.460
    | text      = steering cut out for that long, maybe a second, if a primary system went down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:51.860
    | text      = Even with the generators that automatically kick on fail, we, because of the power outages
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:56.700
    | text      = now caused by the feds not letting Texas produce enough electricity during the winter and summer
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:03.179
    | text      = peak times, had to put in a $70,000 generator to run both buildings here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:10.899
    | text      = And then it was another $70,000, $80,000 to run the wires and all the expensive systems
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.240
    | text      = you've got to have to be in code.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.240
    | text      = And this is not that big a building.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:23.820
    | text      = Those ships have generally one of that size, have up to ten large generators on them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.139
    | text      = And normally two levels, by law it's two levels of backup generators, we can open the phones
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.139
    | text      = up and have maritime professionals, and boy are they professionals, call into the show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:42.379
    | text      = and explain it to you, and they'll probably explain where I get some things wrong a little
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.139
    | text      = bit but in general I know I'm right, they can give you the specifics, and so we're going
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:49.259
    | text      = to do that right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:52.379
    | text      = So he does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.379
    | text      = Right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:54.379
    | text      = He opens up the phones here in a little bit for maritime professionals.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:57.940
    | text      = Maritime professionals.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.940
    | text      = I know that it's a serious situation and I don't mean to make light of it, but I do wish
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.059
    | text      = someone had called in and just recited the lyrics to the Downeaster Electa by Billy Joel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:08.860
    | text      = I thought that would be, I was hoping someone would do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:12.340
    | text      = That would be fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.340
    | text      = So even assuming that everything Alex is saying is accurate, then it still seems the issue
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.139
    | text      = at hand is that there just wasn't solid enough enforcement of existing regulations.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.779
    | text      = Inspection regimens, things like that, that seems to be what the issue would be as opposed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:27.379
    | text      = to some kind of a nefarious plot or anything that your mind might go to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.700
    | text      = These ships don't need to have emergency backup systems in order to come into hazardous waste
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:36.940
    | text      = ports, as Alex is seeming to imply, they need them to be on the open water.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:41.220
    | text      = The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea says, quote, every passenger
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:45.480
    | text      = ship, the electrical power of which constitutes the only means of maintaining the auxiliary
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:49.539
    | text      = services indispensable for the propulsion and the safety of the ship, shall be provided
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:53.860
    | text      = with at least two main generating sets.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.279
    | text      = The power of these sets shall be such that it shall still be possible to ensure the functioning
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.639
    | text      = of the services.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.639
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.639
    | text      = So even if one thing goes down, it's supposed to have something else that can autonomously
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.659
    | text      = run it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.659
    | text      = No one's getting stranded at sea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.220
    | text      = The Dolly, the ship that crashed into the Francis Scott Key Bridge, had a backup generator
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.299
    | text      = and sources are saying that it did kick in, but the ship never regained the ability to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.779
    | text      = steer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.779
    | text      = The ship's local captain had them drop anchor and rudder to try and slow it down, but that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.659
    | text      = wasn't enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.659
    | text      = Thankfully, they were able to send out a May Day call, which allowed traffic to be stopped
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.159
    | text      = on the bridge, which almost certainly saved a bunch of lives.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:30.580
    | text      = There's no sign that I've seen in any of this story that points to anything nefarious having
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.259
    | text      = happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.259
    | text      = At worst, it seems like there was a non-critical issue that was found with the boat in an inspection
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.299
    | text      = in Chile last June, but outside of that, there's no reason that you would see this, I think,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.740
    | text      = and say it wasn't just a terrible accident.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.940
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.940
    | text      = Regulations governing things like boats needing to have backup generators help make accidents
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.620
    | text      = less likely to happen, but that doesn't mean that it always will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.620
    | text      = Sometimes people cut corners, and even when people don't, catastrophic failures can still
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:01.100
    | text      = happen, and it's just an unfortunate reality.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:03.700
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.700
    | text      = Also, Alex is entirely wrong about the reason for ERCOT's failure to provide power during
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.279
    | text      = the Texas winter storm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.580
    | text      = No, no, no, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.580
    | text      = It was the feds.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
